fields.label: Phase
fields.description: What the client reads as the name of this part of the job - Tiền kỳ, Sản xuất, Hậu kỳ. A package points at it by this name, so renaming a phase renames it on every package at once.

fields.label: Blurb
fields.description: The sentence under the phase heading on the quote. Optional - a phase with a name and no blurb prints its name.
